email.subject1: pipeline EarthCam is leaving on the table
email.body1:
John, saw EarthCam roll out Control Center 9 and the Command Watch24 AI security service.

Shipping new AI services usually opens more in-market accounts than the team can cover before reps ramp, and coverage gaps are where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for EarthCam off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
John, quick follow-up for EarthCam.

New service lines usually push the number up faster than the team can be staffed. Most teams can't say how many meetings they need to book to hit target, so the gap shows up late and recovering the quarter gets expensive.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings EarthCam needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
John, last bit of proof for EarthCam.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how EarthCam's reply rate likely compares to peers in your space. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
John, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline for the new AI services without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. A product launch cycle is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your motion? I'll tailor it to EarthCam either way.
